title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Security Copilot explanations of policy changes
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned policy-change explanations and its overdue targets without promising availability. Security Copilot licensing, consumption and related controls are supported; feature-specific defaults and controls remain undocumented. The prerequisites wording should distinguish unpublished feature-specific requirements from the documented Purview source prerequisite.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans explanations of DLP policy changes in Microsoft Purview.
claims.quote: Introduce an AI-powered capability leveraging Microsoft Security Copilot to automatically generate natural language explanations of changes made to DLP policies after each update within Microsoft Purview.
